name: emby
title: Emby
description: Media server that streams your films, series and music to browsers, TVs and phones. Open it after deploying: the wizard makes the admin account, then add libraries from the folders under /media. Hardware transcoding and some apps need a paid Emby Premiere key.

variables.name: PORT_EMBY
variables.label: Web UI Port
variables.description: Port for the Emby web page; Jellyfin's template uses 8096 too, change one when both run on one server

variables.name: EMBY_MEDIA
variables.label: Media folder
variables.description: The folder on this server with your films, series and music, mounted at /media

auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: its own apps and clients sign in directly (the deploy sheet can still protect it)
